angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 598,302 km at 193.81 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.1597 +/- 0.0191 mas (same row, RUWE 1.09): 193.81 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.86 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Carleo et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4515 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A.135C/abstract): 598,302 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.949 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Carleo et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-4515 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A.135C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5433 +/- 70 K from Carleo et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4515 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A.135C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Carleo et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4515 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A.135C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-4515.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.546, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4515 (pscomppars): spectral type G8/G9, from Carleo et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A.135C/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-4515: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4515 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.05 dex, from Carleo et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A.135C/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4515 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.23582, from Carleo et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A.135C/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4515 (pscomppars): age 1.2 Gyr, from Carleo et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A.135C/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4515 (pscomppars): rotation period 15.5 d, from Carleo et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A.135C/abstract)

rotationPeriodsCatalogued.source: VizieR J/A+A/705/A142/tablea1 (Physical properties study of planet systems), column Prot: 15.3 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place
